nodes.Name: J1
nodes.DocComment:
J1 returns the order-one Bessel function of the first kind.

Special cases are:

	J1(±Inf) = 0
	J1(NaN) = NaN

nodes.Name: Y1
nodes.DocComment:
Y1 returns the order-one Bessel function of the second kind.

Special cases are:

	Y1(+Inf) = 0
	Y1(0) = -Inf
	Y1(x < 0) = NaN
	Y1(NaN) = NaN
